name: Brine
author: Erin Carter
description: A brinicle: an icy finger of descending supercold brine hangs off-centre from the top, a faceted translucent column glinting and breathing frost feathers, ending above a faintly glowing frosted patch of seabed in near-black still water.

params.label: Stream speed
params.effect: Rate of the downward interior shimmer and the sinking wisp, pacing the facet glints along the column.

params.label: Column width
params.effect: CSS-pixel width of the icy column, from a delicate hanging needle to a thick frozen pillar.

params.label: Frost feathers
params.effect: Extent of the frost feathers fanning from the column's flanks — 0 leaves a bare glassy finger, 2 grows wide lacy crystalline fans.
